rationale: The reviewer correctly judged the claim SUPPORTED, noting it is scoped to between-gene variation and excludes variants. Their main concerns (no GC/CpG baselines, paralog leakage across chromosomes) are acceptable caveats. They also measured a real ~0.94 log-unit prediction offset (raw R² 0.36 vs r² 0.63), a valid issue the key doesn't mention.
